description_en: Nhū Bāhāḥ is located to the north of Sundhārā, on the right-hand side of the route to Capat Ṭola from Sundhārā. Passing through the carved door of this entrance, one can see icons of Mahākāla, Gaṇeśa and other deities attached to the wall. This leads to a colonnaded portico which opens up into the courtyard. Paved in telia tiles, the courtyard measures approx. 12m x 12m and is home to a Caitya (125cm x 125cm) and a Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala. These stand in a linear axis in front of the main shrine, which in turn is located exactly opposite the main entrance. It is currently (writing in early 2019) being rebuilt.The courtyard is surrounded by residential houses, though none of these buildings display any of the original characteristics of a traditional Newar house. The main shrine building is a two-bay structure, and its main entrance is guarded by a pair of guardian animals. The main door is elaborately carved and has extended lintels containing carvings ofaṣṭamaṅgala. It has a timber threshold and is flanked by lattice windows on both sides. The ground floor is separated from the first floor by a standard set of five layer timber cornices. A special attraction, thepasukā jhyāon the first floor has metal lattice work consisting of floral patterns that have been punctured into a flat sheet of metal: an impressive feat for its time. In 2019, construction work was ongoing above this layer.A single flight of RCC stairs on the outer northern side of the building leads up to the first floor. A plan proposed by the municipality shows that an internal staircase will be installed here to allow access to the upper floor. On the ground floor, behind the main sanctum and on the eastern side, one can find a colonnaded portico that faces a small open space with a Caitya.This connects Nhu Bāhāḥ to Yachu Bāhāḥ.The sanctum of the Bāhāḥ is located in front of the outer entrance. It was severely destroyed by the 2015 earthquake and is now under reconstruction. Photographs published inLocke(1985, 107) andPruscha(1975, 180) show that the main deity house (dyaḥchẽ) of the Bāhāḥ once had three storeys. The carved entrance of the sanctum is flanked by two small windows, however it lacks atoraṇaabove its door. The sanctum houses a statue of a west-facing Akṣobhya, as well as statues of Ṣaḍakṣarī Lokeśvara, Prajñāpāramitā and Vasundharā. A five-fold window (pāsukā jhyāḥ) can be found on the second floor of thedyaḥchẽ,and above this is atoraṇaflanked by twotikijhyās. The second floor contains a secret room of the Bāhāḥ known as anāgama.This room has its own sanctum, which houses an image of Cakrasaṃvara. On the third floor of thedyaḥchẽ, one can find asãjhyā. Thesaṃghauses this floor for its feasts. The house's tiled roof is supported by plain struts, and the roof is topped by acaitya-shaped pinnacle.A copper plate inscription attached to the outer wall of thedyaḥchẽinforms the reader that this Bāhāḥ was established by Amṛtavajra Śākya in NS 763 (1643 CE). The buildingwas reconstructed in 1956. Asaṅghaconsistingof four families (kavaḥ) take turns to perform the daily worship of the Bāhāḥ; this responsiblity is transferred between the families every month. In addition to this, thesaṅghaalso arranges the annual worship (varṣavardhana) and other religious activities. Thesaṅghamembers told us that the lands endowed upon the Bāhāḥ no longer belong to them, and so they are struggling to fund these religious activities.
description_ne: पाटनको सुन्धाराबाट उत्तर दिशामा यो बाहा: अवस्थित छ । सुन्धाराबाट चपट टोलतिर लाग्दा दायाँपट्टि यस बाहा:मा छिर्ने मूल ढोका देखा पर्छ । मूलढोकाबाट छिर्नेबित्तिकै बायाँतर्फ महाकाल सहित गणेश र अन्य स–साना मूर्तिहरू भित्तामा टाँसिएर राखिएको देख्न सकिन्छ । मूल ढोकाको ठिक अगाडि बाहा:को द्यःछेँ रहेको छ । द्यःछेँ बाहेक बाहा: प्राङ्गणको चारैतर्फ आवासीय घरहरू बनेका छन् । गत भूकम्पमा क्षति भएपछि हाल द्यःछेँ पुनःनिर्माणाधीन छ । लक (हेर्नुहोस् १९८५: १०७) र प्रुस्चा (हेर्नुहोस् १९७५: १८०) द्वारा प्रकाशित फोटोहरूको आधारमा व्याख्या गर्दा द्यःछेँ तीन तलाको भएको देखिन्छ । द्यःछेँको भूमितलाको बीच भागमा रहेको काठको ढोकाको दायाँ–बायाँ दुई साना झ्यालहरू राखिएका छन् । बुट्टेदार कलात्मक ढोकामाथि तोरणको भने छैन । गर्भगृहमा पश्चिमाभिमुख अक्षोभ्यको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । अक्षोभ्य बाहेक गर्भमा षडक्षरी लोकेश्वर, प्रज्ञापारमिता र वसुन्धराको सानो मूर्ति पनि राखिएको छ । द्यःछेँको दोस्रो तलाको बीच भागमा पासुका झ्याल छ र झ्यालको केन्द्रमा तोरण पनि चढाइएको देख्न सकिन्छ । पासुका झ्यालको दायाँ–बायाँ तिकिझ्यालहरू राखिएका छन् । यो तलामा संघको आगम कोठा (गुह्यकक्ष) छ जहाँ आगंद्यःको रूपमा चक्रसम्वरको मूर्ति स्थापित छ । द्यःछेँको अन्तिम अर्थात् तेस्रो तलामा सँझ्याः रहेको देख्न सकिन्छ । संघको भोजको कार्यक्रम यस तलामा आयोजना गरिन्छ । द्यःछेँको झिँगटीको छानोलाई सादा काष्ठका सादा टुँडालहरूद्वारा थमाइएको छ । छानाको बीच भागमा एउटा चैत्याकार गजुर चढाइएको छ । बाहाको प्राङ्गणमा एउटा वज्रधातु चैत्य र धर्मधातु मण्डल पनि स्थापित छ ।द्यःछेँको भूमितलाको बाह्य भित्तामा टाँसिएको ताम्रपत्रमा अमृतवज्र शाक्यले नेसं ७६३ मा यस बाहाःको स्थापना गरेका थिए भन्ने कुराको जानकारी दिइएको छ । सन् १९५६ मा पनि यो बाहा: को जीर्णोद्धार गरिएको थियो ।यस बाहा:मा ४ खलकको (कवः) संघ रहेको छ र प्रत्येक खलकका सदस्यले एक महिनाको अन्तरमा नित्यपूजाको जिम्मेवारी एक अर्कामा हस्तान्तरण गर्ने चलन चल्दै आएको छ । वर्षेनी संघबाट बाहा:को वर्षवर्धन पूजा लगायत अन्य धार्मिक कार्यहरू हुँदै आएको छ । विगतमा आयस्रोतको रूपमा बाहाको गुठीको रूपमा केही जग्गा भए पनि हाल उक्त जग्गा बाहाःको स्वामित्वमा रहन नसकेबाट संघमा आर्थिक समस्या भएको तथ्य संघका सदस्यहरू बताउछन् ।

historical_events.event_description: Tha Bāhāḥ was commissioned by AmṛtvajraŚākya of Ukubahāduring during the reign of King Siddhinarasiṁha Malla
The Vajradhātu Caitya was surrounded by an oil lamp balustrade. This was initiated by Maṁgalalāls Tandukāra and Śaṁkhalāla Tandukāra.
The monument was heavily damaged by the earthquake
